# NamedScan

> NamedScan is an AI visibility service for local businesses. It asks ChatGPT, with live web search, the questions local customers ask, shows whether a business is recommended, mentioned or missing and which businesses are named instead, and delivers a dated, branded PDF report with a prioritized fix list (listings, reviews, website content and structured data). On monthly plans NamedScan works on the signals ChatGPT can use. NamedScan does not promise or guarantee rankings or recommendations.

Pricing shown on the site: a free preview (three customer questions, no card needed), a one time AI visibility report for $5 (15 questions and a PDF), and monthly plans: Starter (Guided) at $199 a month (you make the changes from a prioritized list), Done For You at $300 a month (recommended; NamedScan makes the fixes) and Growth at $500 a month (up to 3 locations, rescans every 2 weeks, competitor tracking and a monthly strategy call). Monthly plans can be cancelled anytime. Checkout is handled by Stripe.

Contact: joshuaofisrael@gmail.com

## Main pages

- [NamedScan home](https://namedscan.com/): what NamedScan does, how the scan works, a sample report layout, pricing, how local businesses show up in ChatGPT, FAQ and the free preview form
- [Free AI visibility check](https://namedscan.com/ai-visibility-check/): the same free preview on its own page. Three customer style questions to ChatGPT with live web search, an estimated score from 0 to 100 using the same method as the full report (Low under 25, Emerging 25 to 49, Moderate 50 to 74, Strong 75 and above), how many answers named the business, and which business was named instead. No card. One free preview per person. NamedScan does not promise or guarantee rankings or recommendations
- [Does ChatGPT recommend my business?](https://namedscan.com/does-chatgpt-recommend-my-business/): a self-check for a local owner. Ask as a customer without naming the business, use a fresh chat, state the city, repeat each prompt about three times, compare search on and off, record cited sources, and keep a branded accuracy check separate from discovery. Read the log as named consistently, sometimes, or not at all. No recommendation is guaranteed
- [ChatGPT SEO](https://namedscan.com/chatgpt-seo/): what ChatGPT SEO (AI search optimization) is, how ChatGPT search finds a business via OAI-SearchBot, a seven step plan, how to measure with repeated prompts, and what to ask an AI SEO company. No recommendation is guaranteed
- [How to get your business recommended by ChatGPT](https://namedscan.com/guides/get-recommended-by-chatgpt/): a 15 minute self check with four example prompts, how to mark a named, mentioned, or absent answer, and what to fix on your site and listings. No recommendation is guaranteed
- [AI's #1 local pick changed in about half of markets in one month](https://namedscan.com/news/ai-local-recommendations-change-october-2026/): 14 October 2026 news note. AI Syndicate Research found AI assistants changed their #1 local business in 52% of 245 US markets from September to October 2026. A Growth Rankers check the same month found local answers often differ when the same question is asked twice. NamedScan does not guarantee a recommendation
- [Pricing](https://namedscan.com/#pricing): free preview, $5 one time report, and the $199, $300 and $500 monthly plans compared
- [FAQ](https://namedscan.com/#faq): straight answers about AI visibility scans, how ChatGPT picks local businesses, guarantees (none) and cancelling
